statements.statement: Superintendent addressed the upcoming town budget and Proposition 2 1/2 override votes, urged unity, and invited residents to a community information night on the budget
the state House budget released today includes about $160 more per pupil in Chapter 70 aid
the House budget also includes a little more money for the special education circuit breaker, exact amount not yet known pending the cherry sheet
